buildProposal.decision: Implement the authorized modern-workspace v2 account-to-brief journey and opt-in private local work-store seam.
buildProposal.scope: Build the shared Overview, Research and Workshop shell, account-context preparation, explicit revision proposal and Apply, recovery and opt-in operator-local Save/reopen; preserve source, request and raw-response identities, qualifiers and account-truth versus draft distinctions. This source change does not configure or activate any provider, private customer data, outbound traffic, deployed store, recurrence, customer identity or public deployment. Local disposable tests and historical-response replay verify the seam; no new product inference or account research is performed. Sharing, approval, graph ratification, customer acceptance and production readiness remain outside scope. Existing separate operator preview authority is not created by this build proposal. Require independent technical evidence, exact-head checks and ordinary checked merge without protection changes.
